snippet.title: Opus: Prism Peak - Official Trailer | Game Devs of Color Expo 2025
snippet.description: Dive into the world of OPUS: Prism Peak in this new trailer for the upcoming narrative-driven adventure game, where you play a weary photographer who finds himself caught outside of reality. Using your old camera, you’ll explore an ethereal realm and its ties to the world you left behind, uncover its mysteries, and ultimately find your way home. OPUS: Prism Peak will be available on Nintendo Switch 2, Nintendo Switch, and Steam in fall 2025.
